info.title: video2ctx API
info.description: Consumer-facing contract for the hosted video2ctx API. First-party application and operator routes are documented separately at https://docs.video2ctx.dev/internals/overview.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Better Auth entry points used by the web application.

tags.name: Providers
tags.description: Supported external video providers and their capabilities.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Private research projects and saved material.

tags.name: Research
tags.description: Imports, jobs, cited answers, comparisons, and reports.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Checkout, usage, and Stripe webhook handling.

post.description: Issues a short-lived device code and a user code for the registered video2ctx CLI client.

post.summary: Poll for an approved CLI session
post.description: Exchanges an approved device code for a revocable bearer session. Honor the issued polling interval and terminal OAuth device-flow errors.

get.summary: Search the user’s private indexed evidence
get.description: Searches material previously saved or imported into the current user’s private research index.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Restrict private retrieval to a project.

get.description: Returns the provider identifiers accepted in provider-scoped paths and the capabilities currently implemented for each provider.
Searches the selected external provider. Cache hits cost less than fresh upstream retrieval.

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Opaque token returned by a previous provider search page.

get.description: Returns queryless discovery results from a supported destination on the selected provider.

get.summary: Calculate public trend signals for a topic
get.description: Builds a diversified topic sample, persists public metric snapshots, calculates observed acceleration when history exists, and optionally adds GLM-generated evidence-grounded themes and content gaps.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of diversified videos to enrich; clamped to 8–30.

parameters.name: insights
parameters.description: AI insight mode. Use deterministic to skip GLM analysis.

post.summary: Generate an AI video plan from trend signals
post.description: Uses Kimi K2.6 for strategic synthesis and automatically falls back to GPT-OSS 120B when Kimi is unavailable. The response identifies the model that produced it.

get.description: Lists the source caption tracks and auto-translation targets available to the transcript endpoint. This endpoint returns metadata, not caption text.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Desired transcript language. The backend selects the default source track and translates only when necessary.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Fetch a bounded newest-first collection rather than one provider-default-ranked page. Inspect meta.partial and meta.warnings before treating the collection as complete.

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Opaque token returned by the previous channel videos response.

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Opaque token returned by the previous channel playlists response.

get.summary: Get a project and its saved items

delete.description: Deletes the project’s private R2 objects and AI Search items before cascading its D1 metadata.

202.description: Import queued or an existing idempotent job returned.

patch.summary: Update a monitor schedule or display metadata

204.description: Monitor deleted. The response is also successful when no matching monitor exists.

get.summary: Get plan limits and credit balance

get.description: Returns the account attached to the current browser session, CLI session, or personal API key without exposing credential material.

200.description: Current account identity and authentication method.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Better Auth session cookie. A production deployment may use the secure-prefixed cookie name; same-origin browser requests send it automatically.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Legacy-compatible header for a permanent personal API key. Prefer Authorization: Bearer aty_….

bearerApiKey.description: Permanent personal API key created in the dashboard. Example: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer aty_…" https://your-host/v1/projects

cliSession.description: Short-lived, revocable session issued by the video2ctx device authorization flow. The official CLI stores and sends this value; never paste it into prompts or logs.

demoUser.name: X-Demo-User
demoUser.description: Local development only. Any stable value selects an isolated demo account. Rejected in production.

stripeSignature.name: stripe-signature
stripeSignature.description: Stripe-generated signature over the exact raw request body.

CreditsRemaining.description: Current balance in the owning user account after the request is metered.

Forbidden.description: The caller is not allowed to perform this operation.

InsufficientCredits.description: The user account does not have enough credits. Error code: INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

RateLimited.description: The public rate limit was exceeded.

ServiceUnavailable.description: An upstream AI or YouTube service is unavailable.

start.description: Safe starting characters used to identify the key.

key.description: Returned only when the key is created.

provider.description: Platform that owns the source resource.

source.description: Extractor or upstream implementation that produced the normalized response.

updatedTimeText.description: YouTube’s display text, such as “Updated 4 days ago”.

playUrl.description: Starts playback from the item represented by the playlist card.

totalCount.description: Total comments reported by YouTube when available.

subscriberCount.description: Normalized value of YouTube’s displayed, potentially rounded subscriber count.

businessEmailAvailable.description: Whether YouTube presents its protected business-email action. The email itself is not accessed.

insights.description: Optional GLM-generated analysis. Omitted when deterministic mode is requested or model inference fails.

allOf.description: A persisted D1 record. Database timestamps are Unix milliseconds.

Export.description: A persisted D1 record. Database timestamps are Unix milliseconds.

MonitorIntervalMinutes.description: How often the monitor runs, in minutes.

nextCheckAt.description: Unix time in milliseconds for the next alarm.
